newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end at 70-mth high, eye 1,2600.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end at 70-mth high, eye 1,2600.

text.p: Austrian shares ended at fresh 70-month closing high on Wednesday after a weak opening and traders said further gains were likely.
"We are bullish in line with international trends," said one trader. "In fact Austria is cheap compared with international markets," he added.
The index is close to its record high of 1,257.96 of April 1991. Traders said the ATX could hit a new record this week, "depending on what America does today".
Global markets were reassured by U.S. Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan's denial he tried to talk down stock markets in a speech last week.
However, traders said investors were nervy ahead of the second stage of the Humphrey Hawkins testimony which Greenspan was expected to give later today.
If a widely expected U.S. rate hike was not forthcoming, investors would return to the market from the sidelines, traders predicted.
The ATX index of 21 shares climbed 6.79 points or 0.55 percent to 1,247.63. Among its constituents 12 shares rose and eight fell.
The session's top gainer was microchip maker AMS, up 2.53 percent at 1,214 schillings.
The March ATX future gained 1.0 points to 1,250.
